firstPlayerRule: For the full game, randomly choose who selects a Company first, then let players select clockwise. Reverse that selection order for play: the last player to choose takes the first action turn.
clarifications: In the introductory setup, the prescribed order is USA, Germany, Italy, then France, using the companies for the player count.
The opening Income and Headstreams phase may be simultaneous. Action turns follow the Turn Order markers.
